exposure: rupture of membrane prior to cesarean section
outcome: surgical site infection following cesarean section
cohort: 384 women who gave birth via cesarean section at Lemlem Karl hospital from July 1, 2013 to June 30, 2016
finding: The magnitude of surgical site infection following cesarean section is low compared to other previous studies, and the independent associated factors were duration of labor, membranes rupture prior to cesarean section, and sub-umbilical abdominal incision.
